title: Roasted Beetroot and Freekeh Salad
subtitle: with Goat Cheese
description: Fancy something healthy and with fragrant flavour? This wholesome salad combines roasted beetroot tossed in a Middle Eastern spice blend with creamy goat cheese and freekeh – the hot new grain on the block.

steps.text: Prep veggies: Preheat the oven to 200C. Peel the beetroot and cut into thin wedges. Finely chop the parsley and mint, including the stems. Drain 2 tbs oil from the marinated goat cheese into a large bowl.
Roast beetroot: Put the beetroot in a roasting pan. Add 1 tsp baharat spice blend and 1 tsp goat cheese oil, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Roast for 30 mins or until tender.
Cook freekeh: Meanwhile, put the freekeh in a medium saucepan with 1L (4 cups) water and bring to the boil. Reduce the heat to medium and cook, partially covered, for 15-18 mins until tender. Drain.

Toast almonds: Put the almonds in a cold small frypan over medium heat. Toast, tossing, for 3-4 mins until evenly golden. Remove from the pan and cool slightly. Meanwhile, add 1 tbs red wine vinegar and 1 tsp honey to the remaining goat cheese oil and whisk to combine.

Serve up: Add the freekeh, parsley, mint and beetroot to the dressing, season with salt and pepper and toss to combine. Divide the salad among bowls. Scatter over the almonds, crumble over half the goat cheese and enjoy!

Did you know?: Baharat is a Middle Eastern spice blend typically made of cloves, cumin, coriander and nutmeg. It adds warmth, sweetness and a savoury note to the dish. The word baharat means 'spices' in Arabic.
